name: @calchemy/date-core
description: Natural language date parsing with Temporal values.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --sourcemap --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json --external @js-temporal/polyfill && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --root ../.. --config vitest.config.ts packages/date-core/tests
